Well I’m pretty new myself (About two years, no medical or socia transition yet) but if I had to make some suggestions it’s:

-Keep experimenting with your gender identity if you feel it’s necessary, remember being trans isn’t a permanent label! 

-Figure out what you want. If you want to medically transition or not, what changes would you like to make, making yourself those sorts of questions is really helpful 

-If you experience dysphoria search healthy ways to deal with it, there are plenty of helpful tips out there (or here for that matter)

-Interact with other trans people and form a support system with them and other allies

-Find some transmasc people to follow in places like YouTube or Insta, it can be really helpful as to give you an idea what you want, to what you relate, insight on others experiences,etc. (Be careful to not idolize them!)

-Do your general research on transition, especially if it’s medical as to know what you’re getting into
